description: Creates a collection, either a real database table or a grouping folder. A table gets an auto-increment integer id when no fields are passed; folder: true makes a grouping element, which has no schema and can hold neither items nor fields. Use create_field to add fields afterwards, apply_schema to provision several collections from a snapshot. The table is created immediately and is not rolled back when a later field in the same call fails. A fresh collection can take a moment to become readable: validate_collection_creation confirms it, refresh_collection_cache clears a stale cache. Returns the created collection.

folder.description: Create a grouping folder instead of a table. A folder has no schema, so it cannot hold items and fields cannot be added to it. Default: false.

name: create_collection
